reason: A is the stronger proposal because Ti-for-Hf substitution is more compatible with retaining a ductile refractory BCC solution and directly tests strength retention at room temperature and ~1000 °C, whereas B largely repeats prior Al-substitution work whose cited evidence reports significantly degraded plasticity and whose phase-stability premise is doubtful. A still needs a compositionally explicit Ti compensation and a more realistic density target, but its mechanism and falsification test are more credible.
